content.user_title: Migrate Cloudflare Sandbox Apps to SDK 1.0
content.value_statement: Stable Sandbox applications require coordinated API, image, and deployment changes for SDK 1.0. This skill performs the migration and validates the result.
actual_capabilities: Audits projects for removed transport, session, process, terminal, interpreter, and Git APIs.
Updates the Sandbox package and container image to matching preview versions.
Rewrites command execution to use argv, process handles, output collection, waits, and termination.
Migrates terminal and interpreter integrations to SDK 1.0 preview APIs.
Validates types, process behavior, secrets handling, removed APIs, and deployment settings.
Guides immediate container rollout after explicit production approval.
limitations: Supports migrations from the stable Cloudflare Sandbox SDK to the SDK 1.0 preview.
Does not cover new preview projects or routine work on already migrated applications.
Requires user approval before production cutover because active processes can stop.
Relies on installed preview types and current Cloudflare documentation for detailed API behavior.

use_cases.title: Upgrade an Existing Application
use_cases.description: Audit and migrate a stable Sandbox application to the SDK 1.0 preview.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Production Cutover
use_cases.description: Coordinate matching Worker and container versions, staging checks, and immediate rollout.

use_cases.title: Review Migration Readiness
use_cases.description: Identify deprecated APIs, incompatible process assumptions, and unresolved deployment decisions.

prompt_templates.title: Check Migration Readiness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project for migration from stable Cloudflare Sandbox to SDK 1.0 preview. List required changes and decisions before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate a Development Project
prompt_templates.prompt: Migrate this Sandbox project to @cloudflare/sandbox@next. Update package, image, APIs, and tests. Stop before any production deployment.

prompt_templates.title: Migrate Process and Terminal APIs
prompt_templates.prompt: Replace stable process, session, and terminal APIs with preview equivalents. Preserve behavior and validate command completion, timeouts, and cleanup.

prompt_templates.title: Plan and Execute Production Cutover
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the full migration, verify matching preview versions, test staging, and present production risks. Deploy only after I approve immediate container rollout.

output_examples.input: Review this stable Sandbox project for SDK 1.0 migration.
output_examples.output: Migration report: transport settings and two session APIs require removal. Three command sites need process handles. Production rollout approval remains pending.

output_examples.input: Migrate command execution and validate the result.
output: Converted string commands to explicit argv process launches.
Added output collection and completion waits.
Type checking and process smoke tests passed.

output_examples.input: Prepare the migrated application for production.
output_examples.output: Staging validation passed with matching preview versions. Immediate rollout can interrupt active work, so production deployment is awaiting explicit approval.

best_practices: Keep the Worker package and container image on the same preview version.
Use installed preview types and current Cloudflare migration documentation.
Validate in staging and obtain explicit approval before immediate production rollout.
anti_patterns: Do not mix stable and preview control protocols during deployment.
Do not treat process creation as command completion.
Do not place live secrets in Sandbox environment variables.

faq.question: Which projects should use this skill?
faq.answer: Use it for existing applications moving from stable Cloudflare Sandbox to the SDK 1.0 preview.

faq.question: Does it support new Sandbox projects?
faq.answer: No. New preview projects should use guidance designed for @cloudflare/sandbox@next.

faq.question: Why must the package and image versions match?
faq.answer: Stable and preview control protocols are incompatible. Matching versions prevent broken communication between the Worker and container.

faq.question: Can the migration use gradual container rollout?
faq.answer: No. The production cutover requires immediate rollout to avoid a mixed protocol window.

faq.question: Will the skill deploy to production automatically?
faq.answer: No. It must request explicit user approval before production cutover.

faq.question: How does command execution change?
faq.answer: The preview API returns a process handle. Callers must collect output or wait for completion explicitly.
